B = '[default]Roastery/CurrentBatch'
	qvs = system.tag.readBlocking([B + '/BeanTempF', B + '/FanLevel', B + '/HeatLevel'])
	temp = qvs[0].value
	fan = qvs[1].value
	heat = qvs[2].value
	now = system.date.now()
	start = now
	system.tag.writeBlocking([B + '/State', B + '/StartTime', B + '/ChargeTime', B + '/ChargeTempF', B + '/Mode', B + '/WeightOutG'], ['Roasting', now, now, temp, 'Roast', 0.0])
	paths = []
	values = []
	for stem in ['DryEnd', 'FirstCrackStart', 'FirstCrackEnd', 'SecondCrackStart', 'SecondCrackEnd', 'Drop']:
		paths += [B + '/' + stem + 'Time', B + '/' + stem + 'TempF', B + '/' + stem + 'ElapsedSec']
		values += [None, 0.0, -1]
	for i in [1, 2, 3, 4]:
		paths += [B + '/CustomEvent' + str(i) + 'Time', B + '/CustomEvent' + str(i) + 'TempF', B + '/CustomEvent' + str(i) + 'ElapsedSec']
		values += [None, 0.0, -1]
	system.tag.writeBlocking(paths, values)
	logRows = [[now, 0.0, 'Event', 'Charge', float(temp), float(fan), float(heat)], [now, 0.0, 'Fan', 'Fan ' + str(fan), float(temp), float(fan), float(heat)], [now, 0.0, 'Heat', 'Heat ' + str(heat), float(temp), float(fan), float(heat)]]
	system.tag.writeBlocking(['[default]Roastery/EventsLog'], [system.dataset.toDataSet(['t_stamp', 'elapsedSec', 'kind', 'label', 'tempF', 'fan', 'heat'], logRows)])
	q = system.tag.readBlocking([B + '/TargetChargeTempF', B + '/TargetDryEndSec', B + '/TargetDryEndTempF', B + '/TargetFCSec', B + '/TargetFCTempF', B + '/TargetDropSec', B + '/TargetDropTempF', '[default]Roastery/BackgroundCurveJson'])
	pts = [(0.0, q[0].value), (float(q[1].value), q[2].value), (float(q[3].value), q[4].value), (float(q[5].value), q[6].value)]
	def planAt(s):
		for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
			t0 = pts[i][0]
			v0 = pts[i][1]
			t1 = pts[i + 1][0]
			v1 = pts[i + 1][1]
			if s <= t1:
				if t1 <= t0:
					return v1
				return v0 + (v1 - v0) * (s - t0) / (t1 - t0)
		return pts[-1][1]
	from java.util import Date
	startMs = start.getTime()
	rows = []
	s = 0.0
	while s < pts[-1][0]:
		rows.append([Date(long(startMs + s * 1000)), planAt(s)])
		s += 15.0
	rows.append([Date(long(startMs + pts[-1][0] * 1000)), pts[-1][1]])
	system.tag.writeBlocking(['[default]Roastery/TargetProfileDS'], [system.dataset.toDataSet(['t_stamp', 'plan'], rows)])
	bgRows = []
	bgJson = q[7].value
	if bgJson:
		import json as _json
		for pair in _json.loads(bgJson):
			bgRows.append([Date(long(startMs + float(pair[0]) * 1000)), float(pair[1])])
	system.tag.writeBlocking(['[default]Roastery/BackgroundDS'], [system.dataset.toDataSet(['t_stamp', 'bg'], bgRows)])
